## Professional Summary

Actuarial Specialist with experience since 2019 across cell-captive insurance,
credit-life portfolios, IFRS 17 actuarial reporting, SAM reporting, employee
benefit valuations, and investment analytics.

My work spans end-to-end actuarial reporting cycles, valuation movement
analysis, best estimate liabilities (BEL), risk adjustment (RA), liability for
remaining coverage (LFRC), contractual service margin (CSM) analysis, Analysis
of Surplus, experience investigations, capital modelling, reconciliations, and
audit-ready reporting governance.

I combine core actuarial rigour with a strong focus on **data architecture,
decision-oriented data insights, applied AI, and actuarial systems
automation**—using R, Python, SQL, VBA, and Prophet to streamline production
pipelines, strengthen first-line controls, and translate complex model outputs
into actionable management intelligence.

## Current Focus & Interests

::: {.research-note}
- **Actuarial Systems Automation:** Engineering repeatable, version-controlled pipelines in Python, R, and SQL that eliminate brittle manual spreadsheet handoffs across data preparation, Prophet input/output processing, and downstream IFRS 17 / SAM reporting schedules.
- **Data & Portfolio Insights:** Designing clean analytical layers and interactive diagnostics that surface claims emergence, lapse dynamics, cohort profitability, and capital drivers for boards, cell owners, and risk committees.
- **Applied AI in Controlled Workflows:** Embedding evidence-grounded AI into operational and actuarial review processes—automating intake triage, assumption-change comparisons, and exception commentary while preserving strict audit trails and human sign-off.
:::

## Professional Experience

### Actuarial Specialist — Cell Captives

**Old Mutual Alternative Risk Transfer (OMART), Sandton**<br>
*April 2023–Present*

- Deliver IFRS 17 actuarial reporting for cell-captive portfolios, including

  reporting cycles.
- Analyse best estimate liabilities, risk adjustment, liability for remaining
  coverage, CSM-related movements, cohort results, new business impacts, profit

- Apply first-line quality assurance through data validation, reasonability
  checks, reconciliations, controlled review layers, and documented resolution
  of discrepancies.
- Support audit and formal reporting requirements with clear technical

- Automate data flows and reporting processes using Python, R, SQL, VBA, and
  Excel.

## Selected Achievements

- **Actuarial Systems & Workflow Automation:** Engineered Python and R automation pipelines that reduced valuation-cycle effort, eliminated repetitive manual reconciliations, and improved the reliability and auditability of actuarial data flows across monthly and quarterly closes.
- **Data Insights & Executive Decision Support:** Delivered structured claims, lapse, liquidity, and valuation-movement analytics that directly informed board-level dividend declarations, capital discussions, and cell-captive performance reviews.
- **SAM Model Alignment & Capital Governance:** Led a SAM model-alignment project with external consultants to transition and validate the valuation position through December 2025, strengthening solvency governance and model sign-off controls.
- **Audit Resolution & Reserve Investigation:** Investigated expense reserve bases and liability positions and reallocated risk adjustments with transparent supporting schedules to resolve external audit queries.
- **Control Modernisation:** Strengthened first-line actuarial quality assurance through automated reasonability checks, structured process documentation, and reproducible audit-ready evidence.

## Technical Capabilities

::: {.capability-grid}
**Actuarial and financial reporting:** IFRS 17 valuations, SAM reporting,
best estimate liabilities, risk adjustment, LFRC, CSM analysis, Analysis of
Surplus, experience investigations, reserving inputs, capital analysis, and
audit support.

**Actuarial systems & production:** Prophet Professional, Prophet Enterprise,
end-to-end valuation workflow automation, model output diagnostics, automated
result reconciliation, and valuation control frameworks.

**Data, insights & applied AI:** R, Python, SQL, VBA, advanced Excel,
automated data pipelines, portfolio & claims analytics, executive dashboarding,
and evidence-grounded AI workflows for technical review and triage.

**Statistical & quantitative modelling in R:** survival analysis, generalised
linear models (GLMs), Markov chains, random forests, stochastic simulation, and
reproducible reporting with Quarto and the tidyverse.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var endpoint = "https://formsubmit.co/ajax/ea4a86c8593343c2c78e6a100e14c2c5";
  var triggerBtn = document.getElementById("request-cv-btn");
  var panel = document.getElementById("cv-request-panel");
  var autoStatus = document.getElementById("cv-auto-status");
  var form = document.getElementById("cv-request-form");
  var status = document.getElementById("cv-req-status");
  var submitBtn = document.getElementById("cv-req-submit");
  var autoNotified = false;

  if (!triggerBtn || !panel) return;

  triggerBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var isHidden = panel.hasAttribute("hidden");
    if (isHidden) {
      panel.removeAttribute("hidden");
      triggerBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      var emailInput = document.getElementById("cv-req-email");
      if (emailInput) emailInput.focus();
    } else {
      panel.setAttribute("hidden", "");
      triggerBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    }

    // Automatically notify Ntando by email as soon as someone clicks "Request CV (PDF / DOCX)"
    if (!autoNotified && window.fetch) {
      autoNotified = true;
      var pingData = new FormData();
      pingData.append("_subject", "Alert: Someone clicked Request CV (PDF / DOCX) on ntandosithole.com");
      pingData.append("_template", "table");
      pingData.append("event", "Visitor clicked 'Request CV (PDF / DOCX)' on the Resume page");
      pingData.append("page", window.location.href);
      pingData.append("timestamp_utc", new Date().toISOString());
      fetch(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
        body: pingData
      }).catch(function () {
        // Silent fallback if offline; the form below remains available
      });
    }
  });

  if (!form || !window.fetch) return;

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    status.textContent = "Sending your CV request...";
    status.className = "contact-status";

    fetch(endpoint, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
      body: new FormData(form)
    })
      .then(function (response) {
        return response.json().then(function (data) {
          if (!response.ok || String(data.success) !== "true") {
            throw new Error(data.message || "Request failed");
          }
        });
      })
      .then(function () {
        form.reset();
        status.textContent = "Thank you. Your request for the CV (PDF / DOCX) has been emailed to Ntando Sithole.";
        status.className = "contact-status is-success";
      })
      .catch(function () {
        status.innerHTML = 'Could not send automatically. Please submit via the <a href="contact.html">Contact page</a> or message on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ntandwenhle-sithole-b06896169/">LinkedIn</a>.';
        status.className = "contact-status is-error";
      })
      .then(function () {
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
      });
  });
})();
</script>
```
